summary: Today presents a mixed legal and retail briefing driven by significant judicial rulings on debt acknowledgment and insolvency under Indian commercial law. Market developments are highlighted by rapid e-commerce FMCG growth, retail fashion expansions, and strategic corporate moves by Reliance Jio.

bullets.text: The Supreme Court ruled that balance sheet entries acknowledge debt under Section 18 of Limitation Act, reviving a rejected money recovery suit.
NCLT declared Videocon promoter Venugopal Dhoot bankrupt on SBI’s plea and appointed a trustee under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code.
Reliance Jio is exploring tech-for-equity deals with Comcast and Charter to enhance its technology stack, according to sources.
E-commerce’s share in India’s FMCG retail sales has tripled in two years, according to data from Nielsen.
Former Rare Rabbit executive Lavish Soni launched IATE Fashion, aiming to build a Rs 500–800 crore brand in phase one.
